text: Clear POIs: a poi_store operation (all, or filtered by kind/source) exposed to the web UI and the agent; agent clearing keeps the existing consent rules for keep-out zones.

Named maps: save writes one named bundle (slam_toolbox serialized pose graph and occupancy grid, the POI set, the robot's last known pose in the map frame, timestamp, metadata) to a maps directory on the robot; list, load and delete named maps; the existing unnamed save/reset keeps working.

Load restores the map and its POIs (replacing the current POI set) and relocalises: initial pose from the saved last pose, scan matching against the loaded map, success when the match quality passes a threshold, else the robot reports it is not localised and keeps the saved pose hint; no placeholder poses are published.

Web UI: map save-as (name), map list with load/delete, POI clear; agent tools save_map(name), list_maps, load_map(name), clear_pois; map-dependent nodes (costmap_zones, map_guard_cpp, poi_store, GPS anchor) stay consistent after a load.

Tests (poi_store, map_manager, map_guard_cpp, web_ui, mcp_server, claude_agent, root config), READMEs; deployed and verified: save a named map, reset, load it, the robot relocalises near the saved pose.
POIs are written with the map.
Named maps (with their POIs) can be written and loaded.
The last known robot location is written with the map.
On load the robot tries to match new readings with the loaded map and reorients when possible.
Markers will help relocalisation later (non-goal here); the load accepts an external pose hint they can feed.

POIs belong to a map and are part of it: every POI is stored with its map; saving a map saves its POIs, loading a map loads exactly its POIs, deleting a map deletes its POIs. The web UI has explicit Save, Load and Delete (map + its POIs) buttons; the agent tools mirror them (delete needs confirmation).

Uncontrolled robot movement (kidnap detection) first runs the map matcher: this epic's relocalisation against the current map from the last known pose. If the pose is recovered (agreement threshold passes) the map and POIs are kept and the robot continues. If it is NOT recoverable, the live map and its POIs are deleted (as the map reset does today) to avoid navigation problems, but a previously saved named map bundle is never deleted by this; the event is reported to the web UI and the agent and the user can load a saved map afterwards.

New session no longer deletes POIs or maps at all (neither survey POIs nor keep-outs); POI removal happens only through the explicit buttons and tools. The reset-time clearing is removed by the driving-agent-skills-and-wor epic (task new-session-keeps-pois); this epic's clear ops stay as the explicit path.
